show.description: Akash was once Manasi’s driver. After marriage, he becomes her husband, but Manasi uses her power to keep him small. She controls the house, the money, and even Akash’s self respect, while her past with Aman refuses to end. Trapped in a marriage where love feels one sided, Akash must decide how long he can survive in Manasi’s cruel world.
